answer: Use a randomized re-verification gauntlet. Each epoch, every identity faces five audits, at least two hours apart, and must return a fresh signed answer within ten minutes; four passes are required to earn. Each audit burns 0.5 POA, so 100 sybils burn 250 POA per epoch and need 500 separate staffed windows; responses cannot wander into one shared script because each prompt is unique, be it umber pigment or turbine loads. No velvet rope for bulk farms: missed windows pay zero, two failed epochs bring a four-epoch cooldown, and peers verify signatures, timestamps and prompt hashes on-ledger.
